plan.headline: Compare MRR by plan between the current and prior period, counting only real customers, to see which plans add the most net revenue.

metrics.title: Net new MRR
metrics.description: Total MRR from subscriptions active at the end of the selected period minus total MRR from subscriptions active at the end of the prior period, across all plans.

metrics.title: MRR growth by plan
metrics.description: For each plan, change in MRR between the end of the prior period and the end of the selected period. Plan changes are treated as expansion or contraction, since a plan change closes the old subscription row and opens a new one. Sorted largest growth first.

metrics.title: Monthly MRR by plan tier
metrics.description: MRR at the end of each month, split by plan tier, to show which tiers are growing over time.

metrics.title: Plan share of net new MRR
metrics.description: Each plan's net MRR change as a share of total net new MRR in the selected period, with starting MRR, ending MRR and change shown side by side.

assumptions.label: Date range
assumptions.rationale: Growth is measured over the last 6 months compared with the 6 months before, which is long enough to smooth out monthly noise.

assumptions.label: Timezone
assumptions.rationale: Month and period boundaries depend on timezone, so UTC is the neutral default.

assumptions.label: Exclude test orgs
assumptions.rationale: The data dictionary says QA, demo and load-test tenants should be excluded from business metrics.

assumptions.label: Count trials
assumptions.rationale: Trialing subscriptions are not yet paying, so they are excluded from MRR by default.

assumptions.label: Include legacy plans
assumptions.rationale: Legacy plans still generate revenue for existing customers, so they are included to avoid understating totals.

assumptions.label: Growth basis
assumptions.rationale: MRR from subscriptions is the standard measure of recurring revenue growth. Invoices are cash-based and lag behind plan changes.

events.sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS end_ts, (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS start_ts, (:date_range_prev_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS prev_start_ts), base AS (SELECT s.mrr_cents, s.started_at, s.canceled_at FROM northwind.subscriptions s JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id WHERE (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false) AND (s.status <> 'trialing' OR :include_trialing::boolean)), cur AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.mrr_cents),0) AS mrr FROM base b, bounds d WHERE b.started_at < d.end_ts AND (b.canceled_at IS NULL OR b.canceled_at >= d.end_ts)), prev AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.mrr_cents),0) AS mrr FROM base b, bounds d WHERE b.started_at < d.start_ts AND (b.canceled_at IS NULL OR b.canceled_at >= d.start_ts)) SELECT round((cur.mrr - prev.mrr) / 100.0, 2) AS value FROM cur, prev
events.explanation: Sum of MRR for subscriptions active at the end of the selected period (started before, not canceled by) minus the same at the start of the period (the end of the prior period), excluding test orgs and optionally trials.

events.sql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT (:date_range_prev_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS start_ts,
         (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS end_ts
),
subs AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.started_at, s.canceled_at, s.mrr_cents,
         COALESCE(p.name, 'Unknown plan') AS plan_name
  FROM northwind.subscriptions s
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id
  LEFT JOIN northwind.plans p ON p.id = s.plan_id
  WHERE (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false)
    AND (:include_trialing::boolean OR s.status <> 'trialing')
    AND (:include_legacy_plans::boolean OR COALESCE(p.is_legacy, false) = false)
),
by_plan AS (
  SELECT plan_name,
    SUM(mrr_cents) FILTER (WHERE started_at < b.end_ts AND (canceled_at IS NULL OR canceled_at >= b.end_ts)) AS end_mrr,
    SUM(mrr_cents) FILTER (WHERE started_at < b.start_ts AND (canceled_at IS NULL OR canceled_at >= b.start_ts)) AS start_mrr
  FROM subs CROSS JOIN bounds b
  GROUP BY plan_name
)
SELECT plan_name AS label,
       ROUND((COALESCE(end_mrr, 0) - COALESCE(start_mrr, 0)) / 100.0, 2) AS value
FROM by_plan
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 20
events.explanation: Per plan, MRR of subscriptions active at the selected period's end minus MRR active at the prior period's end, in dollars, filtered by the test, trial and legacy assumptions.

events.sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS t_start, (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS t_end), subs AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.name, 'Unknown plan') AS plan, p.tier, s.mrr_cents, s.started_at, s.canceled_at FROM northwind.subscriptions s JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id LEFT JOIN northwind.plans p ON p.id = s.plan_id WHERE (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false) AND (:include_trialing::boolean OR s.status <> 'trialing') AND (:include_legacy_plans::boolean OR COALESCE(p.is_legacy, false) = false)), by_plan AS (SELECT s.plan, MIN(s.tier) AS tier, COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr_cents) FILTER (WHERE s.started_at < b.t_start AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at >= b.t_start)), 0) AS start_cents, COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr_cents) FILTER (WHERE s.started_at < b.t_end AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at >= b.t_end)), 0) AS end_cents FROM subs s CROSS JOIN bounds b GROUP BY s.plan) SELECT plan, tier, ROUND(start_cents / 100.0, 2) AS starting_mrr, ROUND(end_cents / 100.0, 2) AS ending_mrr, ROUND((end_cents - start_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS mrr_change, ROUND(100.0 * (end_cents - start_cents) / NULLIF(SUM(end_cents - start_cents) OVER (), 0), 1) AS share_of_net_new_mrr_pct FROM by_plan WHERE start_cents <> 0 OR end_cents <> 0 ORDER BY (end_cents - start_cents) DESC, plan LIMIT 50
events.explanation: Sums MRR per plan for subscriptions live at the start and end of the selected period (respecting test, trial, legacy filters), then shows each plan's change as a percent of the total net change.

events.sql:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT LEAST((m + interval '1 month')::date, :date_range_end::date) AS snap_date
  FROM generate_series(date_trunc('month', (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp), ((:date_range_end::date) - 1)::timestamp, interval '1 month') AS m
),
snaps AS (
  SELECT snap_date, (snap_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text) AS snap_ts FROM months
),
subs AS (
  SELECT s.started_at, s.canceled_at, s.mrr_cents, COALESCE(p.tier, 'unknown') AS tier
  FROM northwind.subscriptions s
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id
  LEFT JOIN northwind.plans p ON p.id = s.plan_id
  WHERE (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false)
    AND (:include_trialing::boolean OR s.status <> 'trialing')
    AND (:include_legacy_plans::boolean OR COALESCE(p.is_legacy, false) = false)
)
SELECT (sn.snap_date - 1) AS x,
       ROUND(SUM(su.mrr_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS y,
       su.tier AS series
FROM snaps sn
JOIN subs su ON su.started_at < sn.snap_ts AND (su.canceled_at IS NULL OR su.canceled_at >= sn.snap_ts)
GROUP BY sn.snap_date, su.tier
ORDER BY x, series
events.explanation: For each month-end in the range (last one capped at range end), sums MRR of subscriptions active at that instant (started before, not canceled by it), grouped by plan tier, applying test, trial and legacy filters.

issues.message: KPI returns only value; bounds.prev_start_ts is computed but unused. Add previous_value = MRR at start_ts minus MRR at prev_start_ts for the comparison period.

The include_trialing filter uses current subscriptions.status, not historical status. Subs that were trialing at a past boundary but are now active or canceled are still counted at that boundary; the schema has no status history to fix this.
